item.title: github: Pin your favorite repositories to your dashboard
item.description:
GitHub added a Favorite repositories section on the Dashboard so you can choose which repositories appear there. If the new dashboard experience is not enabled, the existing Top repositories section stays the same.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: visualstudio: Build better applications with Bold BI, a Visual Studio subscriber benefit from Syncfusion
item.description:
The post says Visual Studio subscribers can use Bold BI from Syncfusion to add dashboards and data visualization to applications. It frames this as a way to surface connected data inside an app for end users.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog

item.title: github: A more informative GitHub dashboard
item.description:
GitHub says the new default dashboard was too space-heavy and showed too little information. This changelog post indicates the dashboard is being adjusted to be more informative and compact.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot impact dashboard adds chat and VS Code agent usage
item.description:
GitHub Copilot Impact dashboard’s Agent adoption chart now includes Copilot Chat and the VS Code Agents window, expanding coverage to nine Copilot experiences. This lets admins view engagement across those additional surfaces in the dashboard.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Industry comparisons in the Copilot impact dashboard
item.description:
The Copilot impact dashboard now adds an “Industry comparison” section. Enterprises and non-enterprise-owned organizations can compare their Copilot agentic adoption and leverage against aggregated benchmarks.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: visualstudio: Are You Getting Everything You Can from Your Visual Studio Subscription?
item.description:
The post reminds Visual Studio subscribers that their subscription may already include benefits they can use to try Azure services, access certification learning resources, and reuse UI/dashboard components. It is framed as a prompt to explore subscription perks they may be overlooking.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog

item.title: github: Copilot impact dashboard now shows feature engagement
item.description:
The Copilot impact dashboard now includes feature engagement data, showing how many active users regularly use key Copilot features. Enterprise administrators can use it to identify widely adopted experiences and those that may need more attention.

  • Source: GitHub
